newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia to focus on Nigeria in illegals crackdown.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia to focus on Nigeria in illegals crackdown.

text.p: Malaysian police will focus on Nigerian illegal immigrants in their crackdown on foreigners without valid work permits following the slaying on Thursday of three Malaysians, the national Bernama news agency said.

Police director of Public Order and National Security Ghazali Yacub was quoted on Friday as saying that the presence of Nigerian illegal immigrants in the country would be viewed seriously from now on.
Police would also scrutinise Nigerian illegal immigrants currently in detention camps, he said.

On Thursday, three members of a family were hacked to death while four more were injured in a robbery at a beauty salon in Kuala Lumpur in which Nigerian illegal immigrants were belived to have been involved.
Police have detained 17 Nigerian illegal immigrants in connection with the incident.

Malaysia officially began clamping down on illegal foreign workers on February 1 at the end of a deadline set by the government for about one million illegal workers to leave the country or face prosecution.
There are an estimated two million foreign workers in Malaysia, but only about 700,000 are registered. They are mostly from Indonesia, Bangladesh and India.
Malaysia, with a population of about 21 million, is worried about social disorder amd crime resulting from the presence of a large foreign-worker community.
